title: Stored run (genii.persona.run/3)
description: One player's run exactly as the web game stores it: Session.serialize(state) in quiz64/src/persona/session.js, kept in localStorage under genii.persona.v2.run and exported by Download my data. It holds the answers (picks), timings, Genii's lock and the friend links; everything else (route, profile, result) is derived by replaying it through the same step machine (Session.restore), so a server that stores this object can re-score it with the same code instead of trusting a client result. Restore refuses unknown fields, another kit, answers off the route and a broken lock.

schema.description: Run format version. /1 and /2 saves fail closed.

runId.description: Random id (12 chars in the app). Seeds the picker and the finale draw.

setup.description: Two setup taps. No age question. pronoun is used by the friend game only.

lobby.description: Three unscored lobby taps. voice changes wording only; depth light skips intimate cards; rooms lists the optional rooms left open (love = chapter 3, work = 5, family = 6).

answers.description: Scored cards (chapters and extras), by card id, in the order they were answered. <id>.flip holds a depends follow-up.

ms.description: Answer time per scored card in ms (capped at 600000). Under 1500 counts as rushed (weight x 0.3).

frozen.description: Genii's locked guesses for the 8 sealed cards, frozen before the finale.

lockHash.description: sha256 of canonicalJSON(frozen). A mismatch refuses to score.

finale.description: Sealed card answers by id. Never scored into the profile.

returnTo.description: Set when this run was started from a friend's challenge: who to send the owner's own link back to.

kitId.description: KIT_ID from quiz64/src/persona/kit.js: cards.version@cards.built/library.built/friend.version. Every save and link is valid only against the kit that made it.

response.description: One card's answer: an option index; a list of indexes (pick_two: 2 picks; receipts: ticked items, sorted, or the lone None of these; rank: every option once, first to last); or an exit. Exits never score.

pass.description: Genii passes when the card's main axis is flex or unfinished.
